import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_3/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be added here
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from each source after transformation
    transformed_dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load source data
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Select only the columns needed for the target schema
        # Target schema: ['Major_category': string, 'Median': float]
        # Ensure 'Median' is float type
        df_subset = df[['Major_category', 'Median']].copy()
        df_subset['Median'] = df_subset['Median'].astype(float)

        transformed_dfs.append(df_subset)

    # Concatenate all transformed dataframes
    combined_df = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # If there are duplicates in Major_category, aggregate by taking median of Median
    # This is a reasonable assumption since the target examples show one Median per Major_category
    result_df = combined_df.groupby('Major_category', as_index=False)['Median'].median()

    # Write the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_3/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    result_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
